# claudegrid

> claudegrid is a Node.js CLI that runs multiple Claude Code agents in parallel, as a grid opened with one command, in KDE Konsole, iTerm2, Terminal.app, tmux, kitty or WezTerm on Linux and macOS, with a prompt, model and optional git worktree per pane. It also has a local desktop app (`claudegrid ui`) and presets in `.claudegrid.json`.

Install with `npm install -g @halitsever/claudegrid` (Node.js 20+), or via the `.deb` from GitHub Releases or `install.sh`. It needs Claude Code and one of the supported terminals installed. Run `claudegrid doctor` to check your setup, and `claudegrid --dry-run` to print the commands without running them. The npm package name is scoped (`@halitsever/claudegrid`), and the command is `claudegrid`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/getting-started): install, `claudegrid doctor` and a first grid
- [Usage](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/usage): layouts, per-pane prompts and models, passing flags to every claude
- [Desktop app](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/app): `claudegrid ui`, a local window to set up, preview and launch panes
- [Configuration](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/configuration): `.claudegrid.json` and the user config, with every key
- [Presets](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/presets): named setups started with one word
- [Claude Code worktrees](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/claude-code-worktree): one git worktree and branch per Claude Code agent, claude --worktree compared with claudegrid -w
- [The --worktrees option](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/worktrees): reference for -w and the worktrees key, branch names, listing and cleaning
- [Terminals](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/terminals): how each terminal builds the grid and how one is picked automatically
- [Claude Code in tmux](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/tmux): run the grid in tmux, detach and attach, use it over SSH
- [CLI reference](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/cli): every command and option
- [Troubleshooting](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/guide/troubleshooting): qdbus6, old tmux, claude not found, worktree errors

## Blog

- [tmux detach](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-detach): detach and attach sessions, kick other clients
- [tmux split panes](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-split-panes): split keys, split-window sizes, layouts and grids
- [git worktree add](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/git-worktree-add): new, existing and remote branches, detached HEAD
- [What is a git worktree?](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/what-is-a-git-worktree): main and linked worktrees and what they share
- [git worktree remove and prune](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/git-worktree-remove): removing dirty and locked worktrees, pruning, branch cleanup
- [xterm-kitty unknown terminal type](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/xterm-kitty-unknown-terminal-type): kitty terminfo over SSH
- [Git worktree vs clone vs branch](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/git-worktree-vs-clone): disk use, shared state, when to clone
- [iTerm2 split panes](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/iterm2-split-pane): shortcuts and AppleScript layouts
- [tmux cheat sheet](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-cheat-sheet): default keys and commands for tmux 3.6
- [tmux scroll up](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-scroll-up): copy mode, mouse wheel, search and history-limit
- [tmux kill session](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-kill-session): kill-session, kill-server, windows and panes
- [tmux vs screen](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-vs-screen): differences from both manuals and when to use each
- [tmux config file](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-config): tmux.conf location, a starting config, source-file reload
- [tmux rename window](https://projects.halit.org/claudegrid/blog/tmux-rename-window): renaming windows and sessions, automatic-rename
